prompt: Objective: grow a brewery's sales. What you've learned: bar sales fell 10% and supermarket sales rose 25%. Latest finding: supermarkets now make up half of sales. What is the best next step?

options.text: Check how bar sales changed in more detail
options.feedback: That has already been answered. Build on what you know.

options.text: Look at the brewery's tour schedule for more context on the business
options.feedback: That is off the objective. It won't help answer the client's question.

options.text: Ask the interviewer what they would like to look at next
options.feedback: Drive the case: propose the next step yourself rather than waiting to be told.

options.text: Work out how to win more supermarket shelf space
options.feedback: Right. Supermarkets are the growing channel, so the next step is how to grow there.

explanation: Supermarkets are the growing channel, so the next step is how to grow there.
